title: P3 Class B regressions: gate read-paths and snapshotNative dropped the workspace
summary: Removing the daemon global workspace broke three production read/write paths that callers reach WITHOUT a workspace, and they must not be reverted to a global. (1) The write gate (hooks/orch-gate.js) queries /active-claim and /task/detail with only a session id or task key — it cannot name a workspace. Both routes resolved targetOverlay(null,u) to a null workspace and buildGraph(null) returned nothing, so claims and registered worktrees became invisible and confinement silently allowed out-of-tree writes. Fix: both routes now scan registeredWorkspaces() when no explicit workspace is given (active-claim unions in_progress tasks across all registered ws; task/detail binds to the ws whose graph owns the key). registeredWorkspaces was also added to the route ctx object in daemon.js. (2) snapshotNative(ov,key,nativeStatus,ws) gained a ws param in P3 but three callers in routes/overlay.js (status write-through line 331, verdict cancel 378, supersede 778) dropped it, so readNativeTask(undefined,...) returned null and the terminal-status fold into the adoption snapshot was skipped. Fix: pass T.ws at all three sites. Invariant: a missing workspace must end in a 400 or a registered-workspace scan, NEVER a global and NEVER an undefined path.
